title: DOHF: Online Diffusion Fine-tuning with Doob's $h$-transform Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2609.31882v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reward-based diffusion fine-tuning faces practical challenges when desirable outcomes are rare or conditioning corrections are costly to estimate. In this work, we propose Diffusion Online $h$-guidance Fine-tuning (DOHF), which turns Doob's $h$-transform into a practical online training algorithm. DOHF assigns optimality weights to generated samples, estimates the normalized local correction $\nabla\log h$ under the current rollout policy, and distills it directly into the generative model. Theoretically, we characterize the population-optimal DiffusionNFT update as well as the various classfier free guidance methods through a unified $h$-transform perspective. Methodologically, our framework accommodates black-box and non-differentiable rewards without additional network evaluations. We further show improved alignments under three empirical scenarios. translated_title: DOHF：基于Doob h-变换引导的在线扩散模型微调
translated_abstract: 基于奖励的扩散模型微调在理想结果稀少或条件修正估计代价高昂时面临实际挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了扩散在线h引导微调（Diffusion Online h-guidance Fine-tuning, DOHF），将Doob h-变换转化为一种实用的在线训练算法。DOHF为生成的样本分配最优性权重，在当前rollout策略下估计归一化的局部修正 ∇log h，并将其直接蒸馏到生成模型中。在理论上，我们通过统一的h-变换视角刻画了总体最优的DiffusionNFT更新以及各类无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）方法。在方法论上，我们的框架无需额外的网络评估即可兼容黑盒奖励和不可微奖励。我们进一步在三个实证场景中展示了对齐效果的提升。我们的工作展示了如何以低成本的方式调整概率条件化（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出DOHF方法，将Doob h-变换转化为实用的在线训练算法，通过为生成样本分配最优性权重、估计局部修正∇log h并直接蒸馏进生成模型，无需额外网络评估即可兼容黑盒与不可微奖励，实现扩散模型的高效在线微调。
en_tdlr: DOHF turns Doob's h-transform into a practical online fine-tuning algorithm for diffusion models, assigning optimality weights to generated samples, estimating the local correction ∇log h, and distilling it into the generative model, thereby supporting black-box and non-differentiable rewards without extra network evaluations.
